meta.title: Coach Bobby Simmons | Community Football Coach — Gainesville, FL
meta.description: Gainesville's trusted football coach. Building character and athletes since 2009.

about.name: Coach Bobby Simmons
about.title: Head Football Coach
about.bio: Coach Bobby Simmons has been a pillar of Gainesville youth football for over fifteen years. A former high school All-American and community advocate, Coach Bobby believes great athletes are built from great character. His training philosophy centers on accountability, toughness, and a love for the game that carries athletes well beyond the field.

hero.headline: Building Gainesville Athletes Since 2009
hero.subline: Football fundamentals, life lessons, and a community that shows up for each other.

services.title: Youth Fundamentals
services.description: Ages 8-12. Building the foundation of football — stance, blocking, routes, and the love of the game.

services.title: Middle School Prep
services.description: Preparing athletes for the jump to high school ball. Speed, strength, and position-specific skill work.

services.title: High School Performance
services.description: Game-ready conditioning and advanced technique for varsity-level athletes.

testimonials.quote: Coach Bobby is more than a football coach. He's a mentor. My son is a better person because of him.
testimonials.name: Angela P.

testimonials.quote: Been with Coach Bobby since I was 9. Now I'm starting varsity. He built me.
testimonials.name: Darius W.

testimonials.quote: The most genuine coach in Gainesville. Families trust him completely.
testimonials.name: Pastor Kevin B.

faq.question: What age groups do you train?
faq.answer: Youth (8-12), middle school (11-14), and high school athletes. All skill levels welcome.

faq.question: Where do sessions take place?
faq.answer: Most sessions are at Gainesville community fields. Exact location provided at booking.

faq.question: Do you offer group rates?
faq.answer: Yes — group sessions for 3-5 athletes available at a discounted rate.
